name: Claude Code plugin and hooks for docs
description:
generate-plugin for docs: skill teaching lookup and the condense/prune workflow.
Hooks: on Read/Edit push matching entries per kind push policy (summary, full body under ~150 tokens, counts as read); on Stop run docs affected.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Requirement from the user: the docs skill must strongly discourage editing .repo-docs/*.yaml directly (Edit/Write or shell). Agents always go through the docs CLI (add/edit/rm from #40, check --fix, etc.); if the CLI can't make the change, tell the user instead. Only exception: resolving a git merge conflict, followed by docs check. Mirror the wording of the issues skill (RepoIssuesCli/Cli/Plugin/IssuesPlugin.cs). Note #34 should come after #40 so the skill can point at real edit commands.
